rites.name: Shistyuzora
rites.text: Shistyuzora is the resonant concept by which the Singing gave the first roots of Seornum their shape, a pattern of tones that bound sediment into soil during the Age of Sundering. It is less a thing than a rule the early world kept while landfall broke its old bonds.

rites.name: Tenkaluta
rites.text: Tenkaluta is a sounding-concept of Seornum, the resonance that the first roots of the world gave off as they condensed out of the Singing. During the Age of Strangers, outsiders learned to anchor their goods and bargains to its pitch, so that a trade struck in its tone could not be unmade.

rites.name: Torozhar
rites.text: Torozhar is a concept in Seornum's Era E4, the age of the Fall and the Sundering, when worlds cracked apart and the Shards scattered across the sky. It names the grounded force that held a broken land together long enough for the Pact to be sworn among its survivors.

rites.name: Theden
rites.text: Theden is the concept of the Pact, the oath sworn by the orders of Seornum after the Sundering broke the worlds into Shards. In the Holy Age its vows were carried by temple-keepers who kept the flame that bound the scattered peoples together.

rites.name: Telintum
rites.text: Telintum is a concept in Seornum, the principle that a bond broken at landfall can be mended only by sharing its weight. It was named in the Age of Sundering, when worlds split and the Pact was sworn to hold the Shards together. Its force is measured in what a small crew can carry or stop, not in the breaking of worlds.

rites.name: Fenurar
rites.text: Fenurar is the concept of walls held against the dark, as Seornum understood it during the Walled Age. Its orders and churches taught that a wall is kept only by continual tending, and its first crossings were made by those who learned to carry the wall's own stone across open ground.

rites.name: Thasten
rites.text: Thasten is a concept of Seornum that exists only in the Three Futures, the moment the ending branches and the Library shelves each outcome as a separate volume. It has no body or fixed shape, and it is known in the Grounded Realm chiefly as the idea that a single choice can be catalogued before it is made.

rites.name: Iseshith
rites.text: Iseshith is a concept of the Seornum universe, a notion of the Three Futures in which the ending branches and the Library shelves each outcome. It is most often invoked during the Holy Age, when flame, temples and orders hold sway over the common world.
